metadata.article_title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 185.

article.title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 185.
article.content:
450Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 185.

Section 450  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 536 of the Act
If a person takes or accepts any loan or deposit or specified sum in contravention of the provisions of section 185, the Assessing Officer may impose on him, a penalty equal to the amount of the loan or deposit or specified sum so taken or accepted.
